figures.alt: Contained ceiling water stain and neat drywall inspection opening above protected flooring
figures.caption: A ceiling stain is a reason to find the source before repairing the surface. Drywall can be patched, but trapped moisture or an active leak needs to be resolved first.
figures.before: When You Need a Permit in Jacksonville

figures.alt: Drywall finish materials staged for a thin, controlled repair coat
figures.caption: Once the area is dry and stable, the repair is a sequence of sound backing, compatible patch material, thin coats, and careful sanding, not a single heavy layer of compound.

figures.alt: Repairable localized split seal at a skylight flashing corner on a shingle roof
figures.caption: The stain location does not prove the leak source. Roof penetrations, flashing, plumbing, and HVAC all deserve a site-specific check before a ceiling is closed again.
